name: INSMED INC
moat_justification: Moderate, launch-proven but unprofitable: BRINSUPRI is the first and only FDA-approved treatment for non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis (patent-protected DPP1 inhibitor, ASPEN Phase 3 data, now also approved in Europe and Japan per search reports) and ARIKAYCE is the only approved inhaled therapy for refractory MAC lung disease, giving Insmed a specialized pulmonary commercial platform and rare-disease pricing power; offset by zero positive owner's-earnings years in its history, growth concentrated in one launch, a binary Phase 3 TPIP pipeline, payer pressure, and 17.4%/yr share dilution funding the burn.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 17.4%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
one_liner: Real launch, no owner's earnings, moat 6/10 — BRINSUPRI is the first-and-only bronchiectasis drug and revenue is exploding (Q2 2026 total revenue $425.5M, search-cited), but OE is negative on every base (TTM -$4.46/share, 0/5 positive years), so it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at any price on an OE DCF; the $98.50 price is a peak-sales option, not an earnings stream.
moat_for: BRINSUPRI first-and-only approved treatment for non-CF bronchiectasis — patent-protected DPP1 inhibitor, ASPEN data
ARIKAYCE only approved inhaled therapy for refractory MAC lung disease (liposomal delivery)
Specialized pulmonary/rare-disease commercial platform reused across products and geographies (US/EU/Japan)
Rare-disease pricing power — FY2026 BRINSUPRI guidance raised to $1.25–$1.40B within a year of launch (search-cited)
moat_against: No positive owner's earnings in any of the last 5 fiscal years — moat has never converted to cash profit
Growth concentration: the story now rides on one launch (BRINSUPRI) plus a niche base product (ARIKAYCE)
TPIP and other pipeline value is binary Phase 3 risk, not an earnings stream
Payer / gross-to-net pressure on high-cost specialty drugs, and eventual patent expiry
Dilution funding the burn: share count growing 17.4%/yr, SBC $157,480,000 TTM
